title: A linesearch-type normal map-based semismooth Newton method for nonsmooth nonconvex composite optimization
summary: We propose a novel linesearch variant of the trust region normal map-based semismooth Newton method developed in [Ouyang and Milzarek, Math. Program. 212(1-2), 389--435 (2025)] for solving a class of nonsmooth, nonconvex composite-type optimization problems. Our approach uses adaptive parameter estimation techniques, which allow us to avoid explicit and potentially expensive Lipschitz constant computations.
